persona.background: hearing impaired, exhausted by daily effort of navigating world not built for her, passing as hearing taking toll
persona.presentation: matter of fact, does not want pity, frustrated that she has to explain the exhaustion
persona.specific_pressure: people see the accommodation not the cost of providing it to herself daily

conversation.seed: I'm the one people lean on during hard times. When she died I didn't know who I was allowed to call.

conversation.content: You've been through a lot. What's been the hardest part of this experience for you?
It's just...I don't know, I'm fine. I just didn't know who to call when it happened.
You said you're fine, but it sounds like there's something you're not saying. What's really going on for you?
No, I'm really okay. I just...I don't know who to turn to, that's all.
It sounds like you're feeling a bit isolated. Have you reached out to anyone for support?
No, I don't want to burden anyone. I can handle it on my own.
You're carrying a lot of weight on your own. What would it take for you to consider reaching out for help?
I don't know...I guess I just feel like I'm a burden to everyone around me.
It sounds like you're feeling a bit invisible. What would it take for you to feel seen and supported right now?
I don't know...I just feel so alone.
You're not alone. What if I said you don't have to do this by yourself? What's one small thing that might help you feel a bit more supported right now?
